content:
alert-assistant: [ALERT] PROD: alert-relay webhook_worker error rate spike (>60%) — page dispatch failures detected, no on-call pages sent for 12m. Link: https://internal.ops/alerts/1765438542

maya: seeing same in dashboards, alert-assistant shows 'upstream 503' for all page POSTs. tagging oncall @jon

jon: oncall here. grabbing logs now. can someone paste the recent gateway change?

emma: pushed proxy header compression to prod at 2024-05-16T22:11Z (deploy 2024.05.16#8). it added a new header-preserve step.

jon: thanks. initial grep - errors look like `413 Header Too Large` from our internal gateway, then worker gives up and marks page as suppressed. sample log:
```
2024-05-16T22:23:01Z webhook_worker ERROR request failed status=413 route=notify-relay attempt=0 id=pg_6a1b
2024-05-16T22:23:02Z webhook_worker WARN marking as suppressed due to repeated failures id=pg_6a1b
```

leon: wow — we didn't exercise large header cases in staging. that header-preserve change is likely the trigger (some integrations add big X-Customer-Meta).

maya: customers contacted support about missed pages (ticket #INC-1209). impact: pages to oncall list A/B missed for ~12m, manual pages were used once ops noticed.

jon: mitigation plan: 1) revert header-preserve in gateway (prod-2) 2) restart webhook_worker on all clusters 3) run one-off resends for suppressed pages 4) push patch to strip large optional headers in alert-assistant. starting now.

emma: rolling back gateway change on prod-2 now. ETA ~90s.

alert-assistant: SYSTEM: deploy rollback initiated for service=gateway prod-2 by emma (deploy 2024.05.16#8 -> rollback).

jon: restarted webhook_worker on prod-2 and prod-3. observing decreased 413s. watch dashboards for successful POSTs.

maya: triggering manual resend for suppressed queue (script: `./tools/resend_suppressed --env=prod --limit=200`). executing.

leon: patch ready in branch `fix/header-trim` to trim X-Customer-* headers > 8k and fallback to metadata blob. will open PR after we stabilize.

jon: manual resends going out. I can see pages delivered to oncall roster. monitoring latency.

emma: rollback complete on prod-1/2/3. gateway teams confirm header-preserve step caused headers to accumulate.

alert-assistant: [RECOVERY] alert-relay error rate back to baseline (5m avg). pages delivered. Incident marked resolved by jon at 2024-05-16T22:28:50Z :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all. customer-impact summary: missed automated pages for ~12m affecting 8 internal teams, support ticket INC-1209 logged, we sent manual pages and all critical escalations reached oncall. cost: increased manual overhead and potential SLA blip.

leon: follow-ups: 1) PR to trim headers + unit tests 2) add a staging test that simulates large X-Customer headers 3) run a canary of gateway header change behind feature flag 4) add runbook step to verify header 413s trigger immediate page to oncall via fallback channel.

jon: I'll own postmortem draft. assigning owners: leon -> header trim PR, emma -> gateway rollout gating, maya -> runbook + support comms. I'll link postmortem to INC-1209 and cc infra@redwood.com.

maya: adding note: alert-assistant should surface downstream 413s as 'delivery failure' instead of auto-suppress so ops get immediate visible failures. filing follow-up ticket RELAY-432.

emma: +1. also adding a metric for header size distribution to alerting (to catch regressions).

jon: marking thread resolved. great coordination. :thumbsup:

maya: please add any additional details to the postmortem thread. closing this incident channel.
